hints.title: Days Elapsed from Anchor Date
hints.text: Count elapsed days from a known anchor date, such as 1971-01-01 which was a Friday.

hints.title: Year and Month Day Sums
hints.text: Add 365 or 366 days for each full year between 1971 and year minus 1, then add days for each completed month in the target year.

hints.title: Weekday Modulo Offset
hints.text: Add the current day of the month, take the total days elapsed modulo 7, and index into the weekday name array starting with Friday.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: There are no edge cases beyond calendar leap years since 1971.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Accumulating elapsed days takes a small bounded number of constant operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should know how to compute day of week relative to a fixed baseline or using Sakamoto/Zeller congruences.
complexity.notes: 1971 is a non-leap year starting on Friday.
